achievements.name: Welcome to the Agency
achievements.description: Activate your shelter.

steps: Complete the opening tutorial sequence.
Interact with the shelter terminal to activate it.

achievements.name: A 20-minute adventure
achievements.description: Successfully extract from raid for the first time.

steps: Enter any raid mission.
Gather loot and reach an extraction point before the timer expires.
Extract successfully to complete the achievement.

achievements.name: The Floor Is Lava
achievements.description: Activate 5 traps in one raid.

steps: During a raid, look for environmental traps (pressure plates, tripwires, etc.).
Activate 5 different traps in a single raid session — triggering them yourself or luring enemies into them both count.

achievements.name: The Fifth Element
achievements.description: Unlock 5 different replicator blueprints.

steps: Find blueprint items during raids or purchase them.
Unlock 5 unique replicator blueprints at your shelter.

achievements.name: The search for the Higgs Boson
achievements.description: Refine 50 enriched items.

steps: Collect raw materials from raids.
Use the refinery at your shelter to process them.
Refine 50 enriched items total — cumulative across sessions.

achievements.name: Awesome Mix, vol. 3
achievements.description: Add 10 new tracks to your music collection.

steps: Find music tracks scattered throughout raid maps.
Collect and extract with 10 different tracks to add them to your collection.

achievements.name: Thanks, Sky!
achievements.description: Loot the airdrop in raid.

steps: During a raid, watch for an airdrop announcement and marker.
Reach the airdrop location before other players or enemies.
Loot the airdrop container.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Airdrops are contested — be ready for PvP. Bring a weapon and armor.

achievements.name: Staff Reduction
achievements.description: Eliminate 5 operatives in raids.

steps: Engage and eliminate other player operatives during raids.
Kill 5 total across all raids — cumulative.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Ambush players at high-value loot spots or extraction points for easier kills.

achievements.name: I want to believe
achievements.description: Visit 10 anomalous signals in raids.

steps: During raids, look for anomalous signal markers on the map.
Visit 10 different anomalous signals across all raids.

achievements.name: Active pockets
achievements.description: Collect and extract 300 Active Matter from raids in total.

steps: Collect Active Matter resource during raids.
Successfully extract with it — lost matter on death doesn't count.
Accumulate 300 total extracted Active Matter.

achievements.name: Second Chance
achievements.description: Return to the raid after using a revive beacon.

steps: Bring a revive beacon into a raid.
After dying, use the beacon to respawn and continue the raid.

achievements.name: Smart Shooter
achievements.description: Eliminate 10 enemies with a weapon with at least 3 attachments on it.

steps: Equip a weapon with 3 or more attachments (scope, grip, muzzle, etc.).
Kill 10 enemies with that weapon across raids.

achievements.name: Working Week
achievements.description: Visit 7 different raids.

steps: Play raids on 7 different maps or raid instances.
Each unique raid location counts toward the total.

achievements.name: Provided Destiny
achievements.description: Successfully extract from the raid with Provided Equipment from the Agency.

steps: Select the Agency-provided equipment loadout before entering a raid.
Complete the raid and extract successfully with that gear.

achievements.name: Press F… to Revive
achievements.description: Revive a squadmate in raid.

steps: Play a raid in a squad with at least one teammate.
When a squadmate is downed, approach them and revive.

achievements.name: Citius, Altius, Fortius
achievements.description: Equip different chronogenes in all body sleeve slots.

steps: Collect chronogenes from raids and crafting.
Equip a unique chronogene in every available body sleeve slot.

achievements.name: Who You Gonna Call?
achievements.description: Eliminate 12 different types of anomalies as an operative.

steps: Encounter and eliminate anomalous creatures during raids.
Kill 12 different anomaly types — each unique species counts once.

achievements.name: Elementary, My Dear…
achievements.description: Complete 5 cases from the Investigation Terminal.

steps: Access the Investigation Terminal at your shelter.
Accept and complete 5 investigation cases by finding clues in raids.

achievements.name: Mission: Possible
achievements.description: Complete 5 Priority Raid objectives.

steps: Accept Priority Raid missions from the quest board.
Complete 5 priority objectives during raids.

achievements.name: Extraction Denied
achievements.description: Prevent an enemy operative from extracting.

steps: Track an enemy operative heading to an extraction point.
Eliminate them before they successfully extract.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Camp extraction zones during the last minutes of a raid — players rush to extract with loot.

achievements.name: Fishing in the multiverse
achievements.description: Replicate 50 items.

steps: Use the Replicator at your shelter.
Craft/replicate 50 items total using blueprints and materials.

achievements.name: Shades of my personality
achievements.description: Unlock 5 different Body Sleeves.

steps: Body Sleeves are unlocked through progression and crafting.
Unlock 5 unique Body Sleeves.

achievements.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
achievements.description: Fuse 3 different recipe results combining 2 or more ingredients in Replicator.

steps: Collect diverse crafting ingredients from raids.
Use the Replicator to fuse recipes that require 2+ ingredients.
Complete 3 different multi-ingredient fusions.

achievements.name: Hack the Planet
achievements.description: Hack 3 mindvaults.

steps: Find mindvault terminals during raids.
Interact with and successfully hack 3 mindvaults across raids.

achievements.name: Open Sesame
achievements.description: Use 5 keys during raids.

steps: Find or craft keys that open locked doors and containers in raids.
Use 5 keys total across all raids.

achievements.name: Chronogenes for Dummies
achievements.description: Fuse a Tier 3 chronogene in the Replicator.

steps: Collect Tier 1 and Tier 2 chronogene components from raids.
Combine them in the Replicator to fuse a Tier 3 chronogene.

achievements.name: Physics Advantage
achievements.description: Eliminate an operative while standing in anomalous gravity zone.

steps: Find an anomalous gravity zone during a raid (areas with altered physics).
While standing inside the zone, eliminate an enemy operative.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Gravity zones change your movement. Use this to your advantage by catching enemies off-guard.

achievements.name: Nobody Gets Hurt
achievements.description: Successfully extract from the raid without making a single shot.

steps: Enter a raid and navigate purely through stealth.
Do not fire your weapon at any point during the entire raid.
Reach an extraction point and extract successfully.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Bring a melee weapon just in case. Use sprint and crouch to avoid all encounters.
warnings: Any accidental discharge voids the achievement for that raid.

achievements.name: Dead Man's Chest
achievements.description: Extract items 5 times using a safe container after your death in the raid.

steps: Equip a safe container (insured storage) before entering raids.
If you die, items in the safe container are preserved.
Die and recover items from safe containers 5 times total.

achievements.name: Witness Me!
achievements.description: Eliminate a hostile with a vehicle.

steps: Find a vehicle during a raid.
Drive it into an enemy to get a vehicle kill.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Vehicles are rare spawns. When you find one, drive toward AI enemies for the easier road-kill.

achievements.name: All Clues Found
achievements.description: Find all clues in an investigation.

steps: Accept an investigation case from the Investigation Terminal.
During raids, find every clue related to the case.
Complete the investigation with all clues discovered.

achievements.name: Hold the Line!
achievements.description: Capture the beacon in the Hired Ops match.

steps: Queue for a Hired Ops multiplayer match.
Play the objective and capture a beacon point.

achievements.name: All Aboard!
achievements.description: Complete a special raid event.

steps: Watch for special limited-time raid events.
Participate in and complete the event objective.

achievements.name: Secure, Contain, Protect
achievements.description: Successfully extract with the monster artifact in inventory.

steps: Find the rare monster artifact during a raid — it drops from powerful anomaly bosses.
Carry it to an extraction point while being a high-value target.
Extract successfully with the artifact in your inventory.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: The monster artifact marks you on the map for all players. Expect heavy PvP. Bring your best gear.
warnings: Carrying the artifact makes you visible to all players in the raid.

achievements.name: The cycle of life
achievements.description: Create personal Timeline.

steps: Progress through the shelter upgrades and story content.
Reach the point where you can create a personal Timeline.
Complete the Timeline creation process.

achievements.name: Winner Takes All
achievements.description: Complete combat master task in the Hired Ops.

steps: Play Hired Ops multiplayer mode regularly.
Complete the combat master challenge — requires top performance in a match.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Only 0.6% of players have this. You need to dominate a Hired Ops match with kills and objective play.

achievements.name: Big Brother Approved
achievements.description: Complete a very rare challenge.

steps: This is one of the rarest achievements in the game (0.1%).
The exact requirements are hidden — likely involves completing all surveillance or story-related challenges.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Extremely rare. May require finding all hidden surveillance points or completing a secret quest chain.

achievements.name: A job no one else could do
achievements.description: Get all the other achievements.

steps: Complete all 37 other achievements in the game.
This is the platinum/100% achievement.
warnings: Requires both PvE and PvP achievements including the very rare Big Brother Approved and Winner Takes All.
